verdicts.reason: A gets the hierarchy badly wrong. The body copy is set larger than almost everything else, the 'Reserve a Case' CTA is a tiny pill crammed into a right-hand column with 'Ships late June' and the legal text, the 'Limited Summer Release' eyebrow is gone, and the two-column split at the bottom looks arbitrary. B keeps the original top-to-bottom order with a prominent CTA button and the eyebrow, rule and body text intact, but it has real flaws: the dark header band doesn't reach the canvas edges and the logo is tiny, the headline is small and tightly packed, and the legal line is too small to read.
